Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BITS Pilani Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Field Investigator post at BITS Pilani is 23 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Post-graduate degree in Economics or International Relation with a minimum of 55% marks to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. Is there an application fee for the BITS Pilani Field Investigator recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Field Investigator recruitment at BITS Pilani.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Field Investigator position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Field Investigator post in the recruitment drive conducted by BITS Pilani.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves resume shortlisting, followed by a telephonic or audio-visual interview, and finally a final interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Field Investigator position is a contractual job, meaning it is offered on a temporary basis for a specific duration.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the BITS Pilani campus located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for BITS Pilani, Goa campus, and the job location will be in Goa.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification is for BITS Pilani, Goa. While candidates from any state can apply if they meet the eligibility criteria, the job location is in Goa.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification and the online application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article. It is recommended to visit the official BITS Pilani website as well.
